scope: M6 confirmed create to detail, definite failure, uncertain save and rename regression
before: Submitting a playlist name disables its focused native input, leaving BODY while create/list reads wait and after detail opens.
implementation: Keep the name read-only while pending or uncertain. Save and Cancel remain native-focusable with aria-disabled, synchronous submit/dismiss guards and visible busy styling.
Preserve modal ownership across internal Tab/pointer movement. Outside focus/pointer, backdrop, a new overlay, window blur/hidden state or unmount cancels creation focus handoff.

After confirmed create and list invalidation, atomically close the form and open its detail. Suppress generic Dialog opener restoration. Existing guarded ReadyApp route/scroll restoration focuses Back only for the still-owned modal.
Definite rejection retains draft/error and holds the lock through readback. Uncertain result never repeats create. Rename/cancel retain ordinary opener restoration.

sourceTraceSupplement.text: - Create a playlist, rename an editable playlist, and open its track list. While saving, keep the name readable and keyboard focus within the dialog; repeated Save, Cancel, Close or Escape cannot repeat or interrupt the pending change. A confirmed creation opens its detail and focuses Back to playlists when the dialog still owns the interaction. Internal Tab movement keeps that ownership; an outside action, overlay or background window cancels the handoff. Definite failure keeps the draft editable after readback. An uncertain result locks Save and offers checking refreshed playlists. Rename and ordinary cancellation restore their opener.

| M6 | I can edit playlists without repeating uncertain changes | My account may edit a shared playlist, or a save loses its response | Attempt the allowed action; inspect refreshed order after an uncertain result | Creating or renaming keeps the name readable and focus within the pending dialog; repeated save/dismiss keys cannot repeat the change; confirmed creation opens its detail on Back while the modal still owns interaction, including internal Tab movement; outside actions, overlays or backgrounding cancel that focus handoff; definite rejection retains the editable draft after readback, uncertain saves stay locked, and rename/cancel restore their opener; Jellyfin authorizes unknown permissions, explicit read-only stays disabled, unconfirmed permission never claims read-only or hides otherwise readable tracks, auth/account or playlist-data failures still surface, errors remain visible, and an uncertain reorder/removal needs successful refresh plus acknowledgement before editing continues; pending/error/review state survives page changes, playlist switches, library saves and same-account sign-in; after restart an unresolved addition/reorder/removal still needs a fresh detail read and explicit acknowledgement, without replay; an uncertain creation requires checking the refreshed playlist list before another create; affected playlist tiles say Review needed and their Add destinations are disabled, with an explanation and direct Review playlists action in the Add dialog; failed duplicate reads and empty additions leave no false lock; other playlists/accounts remain usable and returning to the original account retains its unresolved change; repeated positions select and play independently; if the server cannot identify an occurrence separately, explain unavailable Move/Remove actions while retaining listening and safe edits; changing entries clears unreliable selections and preserves uniquely identified ones |
